comment_regular: Verified per-point render builder. Allocates a NiNode into TESPathGridPoint+0x28 at the point position (with a small Z offset), clones the even/odd-Z shared marker template, creates adjacency-edge geometry, and adds wireframe when linkedPointsDisabled is set. includeAllNeighbors=true renders all listed edges; false keeps only neighbor indices greater than this point's index. At the end, if TESObjectREFR_GetBaseForm(secondArgument) succeeds, it invokes that form's vtable Unk_21 with the generated node; because the only caller passes the owning TESPathGrid, the meaning of this base-form/virtual interaction remains Unknown.
